name: P-Card Purchase
description: This dataset lists P-Card (purchasing card) purchase totals broken down by fiscal year and agency. Each row pairs a fiscal year (2018 through 2020) with a government agency, such as FDNY, DOT, NYPD, DEP, or DOHMH, and the total value purchased by that agency in that year. The sample covers 33 rows across 13 agencies, with purchase totals ranging from about $350,500 to nearly $7.9 million and averaging roughly $2.2 million. The data supports comparisons of agency spending over time, identification of high-spend agencies, year-over-year trend analysis, and budget oversight, transparency reporting, or procurement audits.
